author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Fetched work stylesheets inherit the current unquoted url(...) rebasing bug for escaped closing parentheses.
findings.consequence: A valid Reader work stylesheet reference such as url(images/foo\).png) is transformed into a different path before being embedded, so the Reader can lose that asset when the filename contains an escaped closing parenthesis.
findings.evidence: The owned unit embeds the result of rebaseRelativeStylesheetReferences at line 326. That dependency's unquoted url(...) path currently locates the close token with indexOf(")"), so an escaped \) terminates the URL early; a read-only Node reproduction of the current algorithm produced url(/txt/css/images/foo//).png)} from .x{background:url(images/foo\).png)}. The packet-listed tests cover ordinary quoted and unquoted references, comments, strings, and absolute/hash/data URLs, but not escaped characters in unquoted url(...) values.
findings.recommendation: Fix the rebasing helper to scan unquoted url(...) bodies character by character and treat CSS backslash escapes as part of the reference, or leave unquoted url(...) tokens containing backslashes unchanged while continuing to rebase ordinary relative URLs.
